en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3304@2/d: We must remain steadfast against the acquisition of new territories, and must combat the expansion of slavery to the extent permitted by the Supreme Court's Dred Scott decision.
en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3305@3/d: We can support the idea of popular sovereignty, but that must include an acknowledgement that Kansas clearly desires to enter the Union as a free state.

en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3966@7/d: I made my reputation by debating Stephen A. Douglas. These extraordinary times call for extraordinary action by the candidates for President.
en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3967@8/d: Douglas and his party are running on the failed, dishonest policy of popular sovereignty. I want the Republicans to point this out at every opportunity.
en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3968@9/d: We can always point out a few inconsistencies with our opponents, but by and large the Republican platform is a winning platform. If we stick to it we will win in November.
en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3969@10/: Douglas has a following in several of the states that we must have this fall. We should reserve our harshest criticism for the Southern Democrats and their machinations.
en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3970@11/: This party has no discernible platform or political positions on any issue. They are the carcass of the pro-slavery wing of the Whig Party, masquerading as saviors of the Union.
en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3971@12/: Maybe a couple of general statements against them, but overall we should avoid doing anything which might alienate former Whigs from joining the Republicans.
en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3972@13/: Support for this party is confined to the South and border states, and we shouldn't waste our time in attacking them.
en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3973@14/: The Southern Democrats are an easy target for attack. We can excite our core voters while risking little, if we denounce them.

en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3975@16/: Realistically, the Democratic split is fantastic news for us. Let's not galvanize the Southern block even further by attacking them.
en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3976@17/: Whatever our private feelings, we have no choice but to denounce such extralegal actions.
en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3977@18/: Clearly what John Brown did was illegal, but without the obstructionism and provocation of the South on slavery, it would have never come to pass.
en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3978@19/: Every party has political clubs and supporters. I'm proud that we have ours, and they will help drive us to victory in November.

en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3982@23/: Our party rejected Seward because of his unpopularity in states like Illinois and Indiana. Let's wait until after the election before we extend the olive branch to him.
en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3983@24/: Our party supports a high tariff and I'm proud of that fact. We need to emphasize this point during our campaign.

en.1860_Lincoln_Chase/answers_json/3985@26/: I would advocate that we compromise on the issue of tariff increases and strike a moderate tone. We need to do as much as possible to make this election about slavery, and slavery alone.
